notes.title: v1.2 Update
notes.notes:
Rexy360 v1.2 update.

1. Increase max speeds of zoom, pan, tilt, roll by about double.

2. Increase zoom range to 180 max.

3. Export location filename and folder can now be specified.

3b. Export to .MOV ProRes file format.

4. Aspect ratio is now a dark transparent letterbox.

Export video twice no longer hangs app.

Camera orientation and zoom resets when loading a new video.

Previous recording resets when loading a new video.

Disable key-bindings when another screen is showing.
